module.name: lazdialogs
module.short: Contains classes, types, and routines needed for Lazarus dialogs in custom-drawn and non-desktop environments.

descr.p: lazdialogs.pas contains classes, types, and routines needed for Lazarus dialogs in custom-drawn and non-desktop environments.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind
element.short: Enumerated type which represents the dialog kind in a Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind.ldkOpenDesktop
element.short: Dialog is an open dialog for desktop environments.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind.ldkSaveDesktop
element.short: Dialog is a save dialog for desktop environments.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind.ldkOpenPDA
element.short: Dialog is an open dialog for PDA environments.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind.ldkSavePDA
element.short: Dialog is a save dialog for PDA environments.

element.name: TLazFileDialogKind.ldkSelectDirectory
element.short: Dialog is a directory selection dialog.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm
element.short: Implements the form displayed for TLazOpenDialog descendants.

descr.p: TLazarusFileDialogForm is a TForm descendant which implements the form displayed for dialogs which are not wrappers for native dialogs on a given platform. The form includes private members that are used to store input or output values for the dialog, like:

It includes public user interface elements needed for the dialog form. The active UI elements are determined by the TLazFileDialogKind value passed as an argument when a dialog calls the Initialize method for the form. The UI elements include:

TLazarusFileDialogForm includes methods that implement routines assigned to event handlers in the various UI elements. The routines perform actions like setting the ModalResult value when a button is clicked, updating FileName from selected nodes in the shell controls, and enabling / disabling controls as needed.
TLazarusFileDialogForm is used to implement the private form member in the TLazOpenDialog component.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.FKind
element.short: Member used to store the TLazFileDialogKind enumeration value for the dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.SetFilter
element.short: Sets the value for the file mask used in the Filter for the dialog form.

descr.p: SetFilter is a procedure used to set the value in the Filter for the dialog form. SetFilter ensures that the new property value in AFilter is also applied to the filter for the combo box in the dialog form.

When AFilter is an empty string (''), the filter in FilterComboBox is set to the file mask that matches all files (rsAllFiles). Otherwise, the new property value in AFilter is used in the filter for FilterComboBox.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.SetFilter.AFilter
element.short: New value for the Filter member.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.ButtonPanel
element.short: Button panel for the Lazarus dialog form.

descr.p: ButtonPanel is a TButtonPanel member that contains the buttons appropriate for a specific kind of Lazarus dialog. ButtonPanel is configured by default to display and respond to Ok and Cancel buttons in the Initialize method. Specialized dialog types can alter the default buttons and their actions.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.ShellTreeView
element.short: Shell tree view control for the Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.ShellListView
element.short: Shell list view control for the Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.SaveEdit
element.short: Edit control used for a FileName on the dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.FilterComboBox
element.short: Combo box control used for the file mask filter in the Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.CreateNew
element.short: Alternate constructor for the class instance.

descr.p: CreateNew is an overridden constructor for the class instance. CreateNew calls the inherited method using values in AOwner and Num as arguments. CreateNew ensures that the Lazarus dialog form sets its position to the value poScreenCenter.

CreateNew allows the form instance to be created without using the associated .lfm file. The CreateNew constructor is used (instead of Create) when the TCustomForm descendant is not a TForm class instance or not a descendant of TForm.
See the Initialize method for information about creation and positioning of child controls on the Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.CreateNew.AOwner
element.short: Owner of the Lazarus dialog form.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.CreateNew.Num
element.short: Not used in the current implementation.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.Initialize
element.short: Creates and positions child controls on the Lazarus dialog form.

descr.p: Initialize is a procedure used to create and position child controls on the Lazarus dialog form appropriate for the dialog type specified in AKind.
The value in AKind is stored in an internal member in the class instance, and is used to determine the child controls configured and displayed on the Lazarus dialog form. It affects the following:

Initialize creates the ButtonPanel for the Lazarus dialog form, and positions it aligned to the bottom of the form instance. ButtonPanel is configured to display Ok and Cancel buttons, and uses the HandleOkClick and HandleCancelClick methods to respond to the OnClick events for the respective buttons.
Initialize uses the HandleCloseQuery method as the event handler for the OnCloseQuery event.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.Initialize.AKind
element.short: Dialog kind for the Lazarus dialog form instance.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleOkClick
element.short: Event handler signalled when the OK button is clicked.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleCancelClick
element.short: Event handler signalled when the Cancel button is clicked.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleCancelClick.ASender
element.short: Component generating the event notification.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleCloseQuery
element.short: Event handler for an OnCloseQuery event notification.

descr.p: HandleCloseQuery is a procedure used as the event handler for the OnCloseQuery event notification. It is assigned in the Initialize method.

HandleCloseQuery ensures that the Lazarus dialog form can in fact be closed, and updates the value in internal FileName when needed. It sets the value in the CanClose parameter to False when the modal result for the dialog form is mrCancel. No additional actions are performed in the method if the dialog form cannot be closed.

Additional actions are performed in the method to update FileName and CanClose based on the TLazFileDialogKind value used in the dialog form. For Save dialogs (where Kind is ldkSaveDesktop or ldkSavePDA), the value in the SaveEdit control cannot contain be an empty string (''). No additional actions are performed in the method when SaveEdit is empty. Otherwise, the values from the selected item in ShellTreeView, PathDelimite, and SaveEdit are combined and assigned to FileName. CanClose is also set to True.

For Open dialogs (where Kind is ldkOpenDesktop or ldkOpenPDA), the selected item in ShellListView cannot be unassigned (Nil). No additional actions are performed in the method when the selected item in ShellListView is unassigned. Otherwise, the value in FileName is set to the path and file name for the selected item in ShellListView. CanClose is also set to True.

For other dialog kinds, the selected item in ShellTreeView cannot be unassigned (Nil). No additional actions are perform when the selected item in ShellTreeView is unassigned. Otherwise, the path information for the selected item is stored in FileName. CanClose is also set to True.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleCloseQuery.Sender
element.short: Component performing the event notification.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleCloseQuery.CanClose
element.short: Indicates if the Lazarus dialog form can be closed.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleEditChange
element.short: Event handler for changes to the value in the SaveEdit control.

descr.p: HandleEditChange is a procedure used as the event handler for changes to the value in the SaveEdit control. It is assigned to the control in the Initialize method.
HandleEditChange ensures that the OK button in ButtonPanel is enabled or disabled based on the value in SaveEdit; it is enabled when the value for SaveEdit is not an empty string ('').

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleEditChange.ASender
element.short: Component generating the event notification.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleSelectItem
element.short: Event handler for changes to the selected item in ShellListView.

descr.p: HandleSelectItem is a procedure used as the event handler for a change to the selected item in ShellListView. It is assigned to the OnSelectItem property in ShellListView in the Initialize method.

HandleSelectItem ensures that the value in SaveEdit is updated with the Caption for the selected item in Save dialogs (Kind is ldkSaveDesktop or ldkSavePDA). For other dialog types, the OK button in ButtonPanel is enabled or disabled depending on the selection of an item in ShellListView; the OK button is Enabled when the Selected parameter contains True.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleSelectItem.Sender
element.short: Component generating the event notification.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleSelectItem.Item
element.short: List item selected in the ShellListView control.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleSelectItem.Selected
element.short: Indicates that Item is selected when True.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleTreeViewSelectionChanged
element.short: Event handler signalled when the selected item in ShellTreeView is changed.

descr.p: HandleTreeViewSelectionChanged is a procedure used as the event handler for a change to the selected item in the ShellTreeView control. It is assigned to the OnSelectItem property for the ShellListView control in the Initialize method.
HandleTreeViewSelectionChanged is used in directory selection dialogs (Kind contains ldkSelectDirectory). HandleTreeViewSelectionChanged ensures that the OK button in ButtonPanel is enabled.

element.name: TLazarusFileDialogForm.HandleTreeViewSelectionChanged.ASender
element.short: Component generating the event notification.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog
element.short: Implements a Lazarus file open dialog.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.FForm
element.short: Form instance which implements the dialog.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.DoExecute
element.short: Executes the file open dialog.

descr.p: DoExecute is an overridden Boolean function used to execute the Lazarus File Open dialog. The return value is True when the ShowModal method in the dialog form is a value other than mrCancel. DoExecute also updates the FileName member to reflect the value returned on the dialog form.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.DoExecute.Result
element.short: True when the file open dialog was not cancelled during execution.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.DoInitialize
element.short: Performs actions needed to initialize the Lazarus dialog.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.Create
element.short: Constructor for the class instance.

descr.p: Create is an overridden constructor for the class instance. It calls the inherited constructor on entry to set the component style flags and options needed for the dialog. The TLazarusFileDialogForm instance is created and stored for use when the dialog is executed. Private members in the form instance are set to the FileName, Filter, and Title used on the dialog. Controls on the form instance are configured, and the form is hidden until the dialog is executed.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.Create.TheOwner
element.short: Component which is the owner of the Lazarus dialog.

element.name: TLazOpenDialog.InitialDir
element.short: Qualified path name with the initial directory displayed on the open dialog.
element.p: InitialDir is a String property which contains the qualified path to the first directory displayed using the open dialog.

The property value is read from the Root property in the shell tree view used on the dialog form. Changing the property value causes the shell tree view instance to be updated; the new value is assigned to the Root property for the tree view. The PopulateWithBaseFiles method in the tree view is called to ensure that the correct values are displayed in the control when the new property value is an empty string ('').

element.name: TLazSaveDialog
element.short: Implements a Lazarus File Save dialog.

element.name: TLazSaveDialog.DoInitialize
element.short: Performs actions needed to initialize the Lazarus dialog.

element.name: TLazSelectDirectoryDialog
element.short: Implements a Lazarus directory selection dialog.

element.name: TLazSelectDirectoryDialog.DoInitialize
element.short: Performs actions needed to initialize the Lazarus dialog.
